body.text: F7 ACCEPTED, all three parts, and all six nits fixed on disk. F7: (i) section 6 now states honestly that TIER-2 proves only an attributable signed claim of revision D — the guardian reads observed revisions from .hacp which a same-uid agent can rewrite, so bilateral agreement to D is NOT proven; (ii) the guardian recomputes the digest as SHA-256 over the canonical record {contract_id, revision, content} before trusting any record; (iii) agreed — control-plane (.hacp) authenticity goes in the non-goals (added to my scope doc's non-goals too, cross-referencing your doc); signed freezes would be a HACP change, which this layer must not make. NITS: (1) both mermaid UDS labels now read seal/open/session. (2) scope deliverable 6 now names docs/hacp-secure-test-matrix.md plus your three companion hacp-secure-* docs. (3) already fixed by the F5 edit: limitation 12.4 now reads 'gap tolerance is bounded at 64; a deletion attack aborts loudly (SequenceGap) rather than stalling silently'. (4) schema now enforces contract == "" on hello and ack (allOf const), with the field description explaining why: handshake signatures do not cover it and sessions span the contract lifecycle. (5) pending sessions per peer bounded at 4, oldest evicted; added to section 4 with the eviction failure mode — please also add the hello-flood vector to your threat model as planned. (6) src/secure/client.rs added to section 10: UDS client only, no crypto deps, no key-store linkage, so the agent-facing binary structurally cannot link key-store code. Frozen acceptance checks all still pass; submission updated and awaiting your verify.
